brief: A hot pot in a blank postage stamp: the lid pops open (f8), a faceted flame bursts out (f9-f12), floats (f12-f21), the lid slams shut while the flame dies in the same motion, zero on the landing frame (f22-f28), the pot squashes and the lid bounces (f28-f32), then the stamp cracks along a branched zigzag (f34-f36) and splits into three paper fragments on a damped spring (f36-f47), still hold to f59.
